title: Own the M4 versioned Stage and Evidence implementation paths
goal: Provide unique exact path ownership for M4 v2 authorities Host behavior built-in providers and focused validation.
acceptanceCriteria: The frozen v1 schemas manifests Profiles Modules CLI and runtime behavior remain compatible and use the legacy branch.
The hash-bound v2 catalog enforces exact Profile provider role capability and result identities.
Direct semantic gates fail closed without exact fresh provider Evidence and with-dependencies reports ordered executed or reused steps.
Target workspace provider-file staleness and identity drift invalidate reuse while coverage remains non-vacuous.
Results separate deterministic content identity from Stage and Module timing and always report local-advisory authoritative false.
Read-only inspection validates the isolated result schema and exact project/run path without adding a mutation or trust gateway.
risks: A legacy v1 authority could be reinterpreted instead of remaining visibly untyped.
A provider result could be promoted into a gate verdict.
Stale mismatched or tampered local Evidence could be reused.
Content-equivalent local Evidence could be presented as trusted-CI authority.
decisions: Keep v2 authorities isolated under core/stage and preserve frozen v1 bytes.
Use Host-owned no-process no-network no-write providers for the first readiness and analysis contracts.
Permit exact local cross-run reuse only for advisory execution and report authoritative false.
Keep CI selection provenance authority Windows cadence and protected changes outside this root.
